description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git push operations with various configurations of push options, hooks, and ref updates. It sets up and verifies behaviors related to push options and hooks in a Git repository during automated test cases.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or configures a hook in a Git repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: A utility function used in tests to represent or invoke a testing tool or command.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails during the test.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output to produce a stable, human-readable format for comparison.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output or a file during the test.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git refs between repositories or expected values.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two outputs or files for equality.
